explanations: LoanApplication is a record, so it gets a generated toString() that prints every component, including ssn and dateOfBirth. The service concatenates the application into the received and rejected log lines, which silently calls that toString(). The fix overrides toString() to print the masked SSN and omit the date of birth, so any code that logs the object is safe by default, while equals/hashCode and accessors keep using the full data.
